subject: Strategic sponsor briefing & path forward for MedScale
thread_body:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Desai <anita@medscale.com>, Devon Clarke <devon@medscale.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic sponsor briefing & path forward for MedScale

Hi Anita / Devon —

Thanks again for carving out 30 minutes earlier. Below is a concise recap of what we heard, the business outcomes you emphasized, primary risks, and a suggested path forward (mutual action plan attached). I kept this brief for your exec sponsor to scan.

Key pains you shared
- Query latency at peak: inference on current provider spikes to ~1.2s for 2048-token prompts; user-facing search/assist flows need <400ms.
- Cost unpredictability for bursty workloads — spikes blow past monthly forecasts during marketing campaigns.
- Visibility gap: limited token-level cost telemetry and no reliable trace tying regressions to model/version changes.

Business outcomes prioritized by the sponsor (VP Product / CTO)
1) Consistent sub-400ms 95th-percentile for interactive assistant flows (50–200 tokens).
2) 30% reduction in token spend for high-volume nightly batch embedding jobs.
3) Auditable traceability for requests and per-route cost attribution for forecasting and chargeback.

Primary risks & gating items (what would cause delay)
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence and network architecture questions for private deployment.
- Procurement: standard procurement windows (legal + SSO + PO) — target 6–8 weeks from statement of work.
- Integration effort: minor SDK work (2–3 engineer-weeks) and on-prem VPC peering for Private option.

Proposed path forward (high-level)
1) RACI: Redwood (P) delivers SOC2 evidence and initial MAP; MedScale (A) provides infra contacts & security questionnaire.
2) Short-term pilot: Hosted API + warmed KV-cache profile for 4 weeks to validate latency tail.
3) Parallel: scoped Dedicated recommendation for predictable throughput if pilot results meet targets.
4) Procurement: start SOW and security review in parallel to pilot to keep timeline compressed.

Immediate next steps (can we lock these today?)
- Anita: confirm pilot cohort (list of 3 representative routes / payload sizes) by EOD Wed, Mar 24.
- Devon: share security contact and SP/IDP metadata for SSO by Fri, Mar 26.
- Rishi / Lauren: we will send MAP + draft SOW and SOC2 excerpt tomorrow.

Attachments included: MedScale_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_20260322.xlsx (MAP draft), SOC2-summary-Redwood-2025.pdf (excerpt for initial review).

If this matches your read, I’ll convert the MAP to an actionable timeline and propose pilot dates.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
